scope: C-004 check-in Schema, authoritative ProductDate, command receipts, PostgreSQL uniqueness/CAS/guards, DLY-001 draft and unknown-outcome recovery

assertions: submit/correct/view use strict shared Zod contracts and reject client owner, product date, Safety and deletion fields
OpenAPI paths remain authenticated and project the same shared contracts
stable conflict, guard and Safety errors are registered
03:59:59.999 and 04:00:00.000 are bound to different server ProductDates
same ref/same payload replays the original view while a changed payload conflicts
a second different submit requires correct and stale CAS returns the latest closed CheckinView
two independent HTTP clients correcting the same revision produce one winner and one latest-value conflict
Safety blocks before ordinary storage and ordinary logs contain no state values or account identifier

T-C004-DB-001.selector: C-004 real PostgreSQL check-in idempotency, CAS and restricted guards
assertions: two real PostgreSQL connections leave one owner/date check-in and one initial revision
command receipts distinguish replay and payload conflict and survive unknown outcome
two CAS corrections have one winner and one latest-value conflict
a frozen generation snapshot remains on check-in revision 1 after current revision advances
the API executes a stable Safety/deletion guard without direct restricted table SELECT and cannot update/delete revision history
an account-level advisory fence serializes Safety activation with ordinary check-in reads and writes
same-date draft restoration is scoped to the current local session
cross-date drafts are deleted instead of copied
network timeout recovery reads the formal record before replaying the original command
multi-device revision conflict preserves the user's explicit draft and exposes the latest record
UNSURE is accepted as a complete formal selection
